conversations.question: Arrange the following events from the video in the correct chronological order: (1)a guy sits and talks inside; (2)a man surfs on a body of water; (3)a lady spins on skates; (4)the credits of the video are shown.
Can you tell me which option represents the actual order of actions shown in the video?
choices: pole vault --> baking cookies --> tossing coin --> abseiling
tossing coin --> pole vault --> baking cookies --> abseiling
baking cookies --> tossing coin --> pole vault --> abseiling
baking cookies --> abseiling --> tossing coin --> pole vault
conversations.answer: baking cookies --> tossing coin --> pole vault --> abseiling
